entities.summary: Christian Ehrhoff is a German former professional ice hockey player. Playing as a defenceman, he played more than 800 games in the National Hockey League (NHL) and more than 300 in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). In 2018, he won silver at the Winter Olympics. He is known primarily as an offensive defenceman with strong skating and shooting abilities.
